description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart titled “Stimulus Type” that shows the distribution of stimulus categories used in the study, with 10 slices total and percentage labels placed next to each slice (no separate legend is shown). The slices are labeled as Draft/Other (26.4%, dark red), Press Release (18.7%, yellow/gold), External News Article (18.1%, dark green), Interview (8.8%, dark navy), Organizational Report (7.7%, purple), Event Posting (6.6%, maroon/dark red-brown), Organizational Website (4.9%, light purple), Intra-agency news article (4.9%, medium blue), Email (2.7%, light green), and Social Media Post (1.1%, very thin orange slice). No slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the segments do not appear strictly ordered by size around the ring.
